# Tabulator

This directory contains the browser distribution of [Tabulator 6.5.2](https://tabulator.info/), licensed under MIT. It is vendored so the desktop archive viewer remains usable without a network connection.

Files retained from the upstream `tabulator-tables@6.5.2` package:

* `dist/js/tabulator.min.js`
* `dist/css/tabulator.min.css`
* `LICENSE`
